invariants.description: the flux is the prescribed value: j_Ca = j_Ca_influx

bc_sweep.rationale: Fluxes from -1 fmol/s (an efflux) through 0 to +1 fmol/s (a large Ca load for a soma); the module only passes the value on.

baseline.reason: a prescribed boundary value (a constant Ca flux); nothing to validate.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: a prescribed boundary value (a constant Ca flux); its value is set by the network that uses it.
